attributes.cardDescription: A genuinely reusable marketplace-seller building block — identity plus a numeric rating — not a Sole Vault–specific concept. Extends the app's own SoleVaultPerson (itself a subclass of the pulled matrix Person block) so it inherits the dark-luxury views for free.
attributes.readMe:
## Seller Profile

A marketplace seller's public profile: identity (inherited from `SoleVaultPerson`/`PersonBase`) plus a `rating` (the matrix's `score-field.gts`, `l03-ft-score`, tracker `workState: Done`, already pulled into this realm and previously unused).

### No matching matrix concept — checked, not assumed

The matrix's `Vendor` / `Vendor Profile` (`l05-5-cm-vendor`, `l05-5-cm-vendor-profile`) looked like a candidate and was checked first. `l05-5-cm-vendor`'s own `whereImplemented` reads `vendor.gts — contractStart / contractEnd`, and its `reference` field points at `institutional-meerkat/legal + audited kit realms` — a B2B contract-vendor concept (a supplier under a legal agreement), not a P2P marketplace seller. Not a match by *kind*, so this is a build, not a consume. This concept should be filed as its own new matrix row — a generic "Seller Profile" (identity + rating + review count), reusable by any marketplace app — not named after Sole Vault.

### Why a subclass of SoleVaultPerson, not of PersonBase directly

The reusable *essence* of this block is the schema (person identity + rating), not these specific views. Extending `SoleVaultPerson` inherits the dark-luxury isolated/edit/fitted templates for free rather than duplicating ~400 lines of near-identical markup; a consuming app in a different visual world would override the formats the same way any card override works — same as `SoleVaultPerson` itself overrides `PersonBase`'s plain `embedded`.

### Split from SoleVaultPerson on purpose

`rating` has no meaning on a buyer. `Order.buyer`, `Offer.offeredBy` and `CollectionItem.owner` narrow to plain `SoleVaultPerson`; only `Order.seller` and `Listing.seller` narrow to `SellerProfile`. One real-world person can still be linked from both kinds of field on different cards — a `SellerProfile` instance satisfies a `SoleVaultPerson`-typed link too, since it is one via inheritance.

### Non-goals

This card does not carry review text, only the aggregate numeric rating (the spec's "Review" need is a separate, unbuilt concept). It does not distinguish a permanent seller identity from a one-off listing — a person becomes "a seller" simply by being the target of a `seller` link, not by any flag on this card itself.
